asc.concise_source: GSM8K official reference; remove calculator annotations and replace #### with Answer:
asc.verbose_source: Fresh outputs of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B; no Qwen-Instruct verbose trace enters the fit

validation.source_selection: shortest correct noncapped among first four historical candidates

tokenskip.selection: one assigned ratio per source question for training; all ratios only for compression validation

adaptations: Target model matches a published ASC family and size; disjoint observed GSM8K development subset is a method check rather than full published benchmark reproduction.
WikiText variant, selection, 512-token window, zero initialization, EOS convention, general minibatch, and zero-based layer indexing are explicit choices absent from the paper.
Previously observed dev cohort is used only to validate implementations, never as new test evidence or student training.
DAP uses the published framework with a documented integration wrapper and the unified teacher.
TokenSkip uses full Qwen source as upstream does, appends verified source answer, and preserves ratio conditioning. Gold correctness after appending is not evidence of reasoning validity.
64-question method checks do not complete the 7.5K or 25K distillation protocol.
The preliminary pool is selected using historical Qwen traces, but only question/reference text is used to generate actual R1 calibration outputs. Selection provenance is retained.

calibration_generation.selection: first correct noncapped target-model candidate longer than reference; stable pool order; stop at 100 unique pairs
